cases.name: byte_extension_is_not_a_register_copy
cases.description: An in-place byte zero-extension clears the rest of the architectural register even though both views share the same Mreg.

cases.name: byte_to_quad_extension_uses_the_source_view
cases.description: A byte-to-64-bit zero-extension may not be replaced by a 32-bit conversion.

cases.name: word_to_quad_extension_uses_the_source_view
cases.description: A word-to-64-bit zero-extension may not be replaced by a 32-bit conversion.

cases.name: word_extension_is_not_a_register_copy
cases.description: A word zero-extension is a value transform, not an identity alias between overlapping register views.
